title: Korea and Her Neighbors
summary: LibriVox recording of Korea and Her Neighbors by Isabella L. Bird. Read in English by Availle. In this book, Isabella L. Bird, who had been elected a Fellow of the Royal Geographical Society only 2 years prior, describes her travels through Korea from 1894 - 1897 in her well-known style.
